chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Kohl grows the hair, dries the tears, freshens the saliva, and clears the vision.

key_terms.الْكُحْلُ: Kohl (eyeliner), a cosmetic and medicinal substance applied to the eyes

ai.seo_question: What are the health and beauty benefits of using kohl according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi*’s chapter on physical hygiene, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) reflects the Shia tradition of integrating prophetic medicine (*al-tibb al-nabawi*) with daily rituals. The four benefits—promoting eyelash growth, drying tears, improving saliva taste, and clarifying vision—underscore the holistic approach to health in Shia jurisprudence, where aesthetic care is viewed as a means to enhance both physical well-being and spiritual cleanliness.
